description: Primary lifecycle status for ChemDesk content items such as chapters, lectures, notes, concepts, and future pages.

statuses.label: Raw
statuses.description: Initial scaffold or imported metadata. Not reviewed and not student-facing.

statuses.label: Draft
statuses.description: Work-in-progress content or structure. Not approved for student-facing publication.

statuses.label: Ready for Review
statuses.description: Prepared for agent or human review but not approved.

statuses.label: Approved
statuses.description: Reviewed and approved internally. May still need a publish step before public display.

statuses.label: Published
statuses.description: Approved and available for student-facing use.

statuses.label: Archived
statuses.description: Retired from active use but preserved for history or rollback.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.description: Not suitable for use. Kept only if needed for audit/history.

notes: Only published content is public/RAG eligible by default.
